verdict.rationale: Pylon's Triggers feature explicitly supports defining event-based automations with premade templates and custom rules (pylon-docs-30, pylon-docs-62), backed by webhooks for event-driven callbacks (pylon-docs-32, pylon-docs-63) and an API for programmatic actions (pylon-docs-31, pylon-docs-35). This directly matches the story of defining rules that trigger actions on events. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of trigger reliability, and more detail on the range/complexity of conditions supported beyond templates.
